h1: Heart of Harmony Master Plan: A Detailed Look at the Site Layout, Tower Design & Floor Plans

blocks.text: The master plan of any residential project tells you more than a brochure render ever can. It reveals how a developer thinks about space, privacy, green areas, movement, and the daily lived experience of residents. CKPC Heart of Harmony is a focused single-tower development — every design decision concentrates quality rather than spreading it thin.

For the full project overview including RERA details, explore the full project overview . This guide focuses specifically on how Heart of Harmony’s master plan — designed with a single-tower, low-density philosophy — translates into quality of life for every resident.
Project Overview

rows: Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068

blocks.text: Understanding the Heart of Harmony Master Plan

The master plan is built around three core principles: low density, vertical luxury, and thoughtfully distributed amenities. Unlike large township projects with multiple towers, Heart of Harmony is a focused single-tower development — every design decision concentrates quality rather than spreading it thin.
Site Boundary & Setbacks

The site is developed with BBMP-approved setbacks on all four sides, creating a green buffer between Hosur Main Road and the residential tower. 84% of the total site area is maintained as open green space — exceptional for an urban high-rise context.
Entry & Exit Points

Separate entry and exit points for vehicles are designated in the master plan. Visitor parking is managed at surface or basement level, keeping the podium and upper levels entirely car-free. Pedestrian access from the main gate to the lobby is sheltered and unobstructed.
Basement Levels

Two basement levels provide covered parking for all 137 units plus visitor parking. All MEP infrastructure — power backup, water storage, pump rooms, and service access — is housed in the basement, keeping technical systems completely out of the podium and residential floors.
Tower Structure: 2 Basement + Ground + 24 Floors
Ground Floor
Primary lobby, security desk, parcel room, and building management office. Direct connection to the vehicle-free podium-level amenity deck makes the arrival-to-amenity transition seamless.
Podium Level — Vehicle-Free Amenity Deck
Elevated above street grade and parking, the podium creates a car-free, green platform:

items: Sports: Basketball practice court, jogging track, bicycle track, outdoor gym, pickleball court, rock climbing wall, play courts
Social: Amphitheatre, sundowner fire pit, meet & greet zone, sculpture court
Children: Tot lot, children’s play zones
Nature: Landscaped gardens, nature trail, reflexology path, paw park, star gazing deck

blocks.text: For a full breakdown of all 40+ amenities across both podium and rooftop levels, read our Heart of Harmony amenities guide .
Rooftop Terrace — Clubhouse
The rooftop terrace houses the clubhouse against panoramic skyline views:

items: Swimming pool with paddle pool and lazy pool
Spa, sauna and steam suite | Ice bath facility
Banquet hall with kitchen | Co-working space | Multipurpose activity room | Indoor games

blocks.text: Residential Floors 1 to 24

Entirely residential from Floor 1 to Floor 24. Only 6 homes per floor — each level served by a compact lift lobby corridor that feels private rather than busy. Floor-to-ceiling height designed in the 9.5–10 feet range — a premium specification that changes the perceived scale of every room.

One of the distinctive features of the master plan is the open-to-sky garden terraces placed every three floors, bringing greenery and outdoor space closer to every resident without requiring a trip to the ground level. See how residents use the private sky garden terraces
Heart of Harmony Floor Plans: Configuration Guide
3 BHK Floor Plan

Three full bedrooms with attached bathrooms, spacious living-dining flowing to a private balcony, modular kitchen with utility balcony, master bedroom with walk-in wardrobe provision. Confirmed carpet area: 1,786 sq ft and 1,981 sq ft. Buyers looking at 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments for sale in Kudlu Gate can see how these configurations sit within the master plan’s 6-homes-per-floor layout.
3.5 BHK Floor Plan

Three bedrooms plus a dedicated study or home office room — the defining feature for post-2020 luxury buyers who work from home. Larger living-dining, dual balcony in select units. Confirmed carpet area: 2,132 sq ft.
4 BHK Floor Plan

Four full bedrooms each with attached bathroom, grand entrance foyer, formal living and dining zones, full-size modular kitchen, and two or more private balconies. Confirmed carpet area: 2,550 sq ft. View all floor plans and configurations
What Sets the Heart of Harmony Master Plan Apart
RERA Compliance & Approved Plans

All floor plans and the master plan are submitted to and approved by Karnataka RERA. The plans in the brochure are the plans approved for construction — no undisclosed changes are permitted. Verify at rera.karnataka.gov.in using RERA number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .

FAQs: Heart of Harmony Master Plan

items.q: How many homes are there per floor?
items.a: Just 6 homes per floor across all 24 residential floors — a deliberate low-density choice for privacy and exclusivity. This is significantly lower than the industry standard of 8–16 homes per floor in comparable luxury projects.

items.q: What is the total number of units?
items.a: 137 homes in total, across 3 BHK (1,786 sq ft and 1,981 sq ft), 3.5 BHK (2,132 sq ft), and 4 BHK Grande (2,550 sq ft) configurations.

items.q: Are the floor plans approved by RERA?
items.a: Yes. All floor plans and the master plan are approved by Karnataka RERA. Registration: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 . Verify at rera.karnataka.gov.in.

items.q: Where are the amenities located in the master plan?
items.a: Across two levels: the vehicle-free podium deck (outdoor sports, gardens, social spaces) and the rooftop terrace clubhouse (pool, gym, spa, indoor amenities). See the full amenities guide for the complete 40+ facility list.

items.q: When is Heart of Harmony possession?
items.a: March 2030 per the RERA-registered timeline. Verifiable at rera.karnataka.gov.in using RERA number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .
